1. ESTABLISH – TOW AWAY, NO STOPPING, 12 PM TO 10 PM, DAILY
Washington Street, north side, from 14 feet to 32 feet west of Fillmore Street (in meter 2502)
(Supervisor District 2) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Brian Manford,
[staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to add meter signage at meter 2502 for movable Shared Spaces parklet. Proposal to
establish parking restriction for an approved movable parklet during their parklet operating hours (12
PM to 10 PM daily).

Public Comments: Received comments in support during hearing.
